tokens.name: surface-chrome
tokens.usage: Workspace title bar, tool rail and status bar.

tokens.name: surface-side
tokens.usage: Workspace sidebar, desk strip and outline panel.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Note editor ground and the margin-track outline. The calmest surface in the app.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Section tiles, desk cards, inputs and segmented controls sitting on surface-side.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered rows, the current outline heading, count pills and pressed icon buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Workspace dividers, card and tile borders, tree indent guides.

tokens.name: line-note
tokens.usage: Borders inside a note: code blocks and rules.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, note titles, folder rows and primary UI text, on every workspace surface.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Ordinary UI text (tree rows, desk cards, panel links) on surface-side, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: note-text
tokens.usage: Note body copy on surface.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, counts, timestamps and caps labels on every workspace surface including surface-hover (5.1:1 or better).

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Decorative icons, arrows and tree chevrons only, never text. Meets 3:1 on surface-chrome and surface-side.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Selection borders, current-position markers and the active diamond in the workspace. A mark, not a text colour.

tokens.name: cyan-fill
tokens.usage: Solid fills for the active Domain tab, segmented control and inspector tab; also the focus ring. Text on it is on-cyan.

tokens.name: on-cyan
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a cyan-fill fill (4.5:1 light, 9:1 dark).

tokens.name: cyan-glow
tokens.usage: Soft halo around selected tiles and desk cards, and the viewport bar of the margin track.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Background of the open note in the tree and the active tool in the rail.

tokens.name: on-selection
tokens.usage: Text and icon on selection.

tokens.name: gold-hi
tokens.usage: Top stop of the vault-name gradient.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Middle stop of the vault-name gradient; pinned-item diamonds. Vault names only at 24px or larger (3.5:1 on the frost and surface-side).

tokens.name: gold-lo
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the vault-name gradient.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Resolved wikilinks and outline link items, on surface and surface-side.

tokens.name: link-underline
tokens.usage: The 1px underline under a resolved wikilink.

tokens.name: link-missing
tokens.usage: A wikilink to a note that does not exist yet; drawn with a dashed underline. Alias of muted.

tokens.name: pdf
tokens.usage: The PDF badge and PDF dots on the margin track.

tokens.name: on-pdf
tokens.usage: The letters PDF on a pdf badge.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Tag chips in the note header and properties list.

tokens.name: on-chip
tokens.usage: Tag text on chip.

tokens.name: code-surface
tokens.usage: Code block ground.

tokens.name: code-gutter
tokens.usage: Line numbers on code-surface (4.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: syntax-keyword
tokens.usage: Language keywords (function, end, if) on code-surface.

tokens.name: syntax-comment
tokens.usage: Comments, set italic, on code-surface.

tokens.name: syntax-builtin
tokens.usage: Built-in functions and numeric literals on code-surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive text buttons (Delete Vault…) on the dialog and side surfaces. Always paired with a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: domain-academic
tokens.usage: Academic Domain marker: diamonds, folder icons, section-tile icons, daily-note tile strip. Meets 3:1 as an icon on every surface.

tokens.name: domain-academic-soft
tokens.usage: Folder icon fill and backlink highlight in the Academic Domain.

tokens.name: domain-academic-band
tokens.usage: Academic diamonds on the dark chooser band.

tokens.name: domain-work
tokens.usage: Work Domain marker, used like domain-academic.

tokens.name: domain-work-soft
tokens.usage: Folder icon fill and highlights in the Work Domain.

tokens.name: domain-work-band
tokens.usage: Work diamonds on the dark chooser band.

tokens.name: domain-personal
tokens.usage: Personal Domain marker, used like domain-academic.

tokens.name: domain-personal-soft
tokens.usage: Folder icon fill and highlights in the Personal Domain.

tokens.name: domain-personal-band
tokens.usage: Personal diamonds on the dark chooser band.

tokens.name: chooser-ground
tokens.usage: Vault chooser background, under the marble veining. The chooser is light-only.

tokens.name: chooser-topbar
tokens.usage: Top stop of the chooser top-bar gradient.

tokens.name: chooser-topbar-end
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the chooser top-bar gradient.

tokens.name: chooser-topbar-rule
tokens.usage: The 5px rule under the chooser top bar.

tokens.name: chooser-panel
tokens.usage: The framed panel that holds the Vault cards.

tokens.name: chooser-panel-line
tokens.usage: Outer border of the chooser panel and the New / Edit Vault dialog; secondary button borders there.

tokens.name: chooser-panel-inset
tokens.usage: The inner hairline of the double frame, and dividers inside the dialog.

tokens.name: chooser-ink
tokens.usage: Screen and dialog titles on chooser-ground and chooser-topbar.

tokens.name: chooser-ink-2
tokens.usage: Labels, footer hints, inactive tabs and the New Vault card on chooser surfaces.

tokens.name: chooser-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary chooser text (Vault meta lines, hints) on chooser-ground, the frost and the panel (5.2:1).

tokens.name: chooser-card-frame
tokens.usage: Border of an unselected Vault card.

tokens.name: chooser-new-dash
tokens.usage: Dashed border of the New Vault card.

tokens.name: chooser-frost
tokens.usage: The frosted lower third of a Vault card, where the name sits; also the dialog ground.

tokens.name: chooser-select
tokens.usage: Selected Vault card border and glow. Only 1.6:1 on chooser-ground, so selection must also show by the 8px lift, the Enter keycap and the pencil button.

tokens.name: chooser-select-glow
tokens.usage: Outer glow of the selected Vault card.

tokens.name: chooser-band
tokens.usage: The dark translucent band naming the active Domain.

tokens.name: chooser-band-ink
tokens.usage: Domain name on chooser-band.

tokens.name: chooser-ornament
tokens.usage: Corner brackets and diamond gems on the chooser panel, cards and dialog.

tokens.name: chooser-ornament-line
tokens.usage: Outline of the ornament diamonds.

tokens.name: keycap
tokens.usage: Keyboard hint caps on chooser surfaces.

tokens.name: keycap-strong
tokens.usage: The Enter cap on the selected card and the primary dialog button ground.

tokens.name: on-keycap
tokens.usage: Glyphs on keycap and keycap-strong (7.9:1 or better).

styles.name: button

styles.name: ui-small

styles.name: ui-meta
styles.usage: Counts, timestamps and secondary lines, in muted.

styles.name: label-caps
